route.title: Train and resume a tiny module, then inspect MLP and CNN models
route.scope: Actually train the existing 76-parameter public module for 400 tiny SGD steps, compare every loss and saved float with its reference loop, and resume from step 200. Then construct the public 3322-parameter MLP and 2910-parameter CNN, execute synthetic zero-model gradients and demonstrate atomic refusal of unrepresentable compute weights.
limitations: Only the tiny fixed module is trained here. The MLP and CNN steps are dataset-free API/refusal examples and do not rerun the frozen MNIST learning experiments.
Retained MLP/CNN quality, independent gradients, replay and export records remain separate. Exact example output does not requalify those experiments on this compiler or host.

Convolution is CPU f32 NCHW/OIHW valid stride one with formal first-order f64 tape derivatives. GPU convolution, compiled convolution backward, higher-order transforms, pooling and broader architecture acceptance remain outside this route.
Examples do not count as product adoption. The native mnist-experiment.coax and cnn-experiment.coax consumers retain separate workload and quality gates.

prerequisites.compiler: An existing Coax executable with native C emission, supplied with --coax. Receipts bind its actual bytes and options; the runner does not build it.
prerequisites.hardware: CPU terminal; retained observations are Apple silicon/macOS. Another host requires its own matching receipt. No GPU or browser is required.

revision_scope: Git HEAD at observation; source hashes, not a claim that the worktree is clean or published.
scope: Exact selected native examples and declared workflow, not all book capabilities, product adoption, live transport, browser rendering or production deployment.
